summary: ASC là một front-end decompiler Android siêu nhanh cho nhà nghiên cứu Agents/Mobile, cho phép phân tích ngược ứng dụng để tìm bảo mật lỗ hổng.
usecases: Analyze Android applications for hardcoded secrets, API keys, and insecure storage during security audits.
Facilitate malware analysis and threat research by decompiling suspicious apps for behavioral inspection.
Assist developers in recovering lost source code or understanding third-party library implementations for interoperability.
ideas: Integrate ASC with AI agents to automatically identify potential security vulnerabilities in decompiled code.
Build a web-based UI on top of ASC for collaborative reverse-engineering and findings sharing.
Develop a plugin that maps decompiled Smali code to high-level security best practices and compliance checks.
